home.title: Your own cloud, on your own hardware
home.description: VMs, apps, storage and networking in one Rust platform. Install it on a mini PC, a NAS box or a rack server and run everything from one console, one CLI and one API.

tide.title: Tide · Compute
tide.description: Run Windows, Home Assistant OS or OPNsense as full VMs, and every app in its own small VM with its own kernel. One console, one API, no YAML required.

reef.title: Reef · Storage
reef.description: Pools, shares, S3 buckets, databases and backups in one place. Reef watches your disks, runs your scrubs and tells you before something fails.

current.title: Current · Networking
current.description: Bridges, VLANs and firewalling with eBPF. Every app gets a local name with a valid certificate, and remote access works without opening ports.

molt.title: Molt · Upgrades
molt.description: Crustates runs on a read-only, image-based OS. Every update is one signed image. If something breaks, roll back in one step, from the console or the recovery screen.

cast.title: Cast · Clusters
cast.description: Start with one node. Add another at home, at a relative's place or on a VPS, and manage them as one. Nodes find each other by key, not by IP address.

barnacle.title: Barnacle · Plugins
barnacle.description: Barnacle plugins are sandboxed WebAssembly components running in Wasmtime. Each one declares the capabilities it needs, and you approve them on install.

spawn.title: Spawn · GitOps
spawn.description: Describe your apps, VMs and network in YAML, open a pull request, read the plan, merge. Or push your own code and let Crustates build and deploy it.

assistant.title: AI assistant
assistant.description: A built-in assistant that knows your VMs, apps, pools and networks. When you want it to act, it shows you a plan first and waits for your OK.

features.title: Features
features.description: Everything a homelab needs, in one platform you own: compute, storage and networking, with upgrades and clustering built in. One console, one CLI and one API on every node.

compare.title: Compare
compare.description: How Crustates compares with Proxmox, TrueNAS and Unraid, honestly: where it is headed and what ships today.

hardware.title: Hardware guide
hardware.description: Crustates runs on most 64-bit machines from the last ten years, on amd64 and arm64. What to buy, what to avoid and how the installer checks your box.

plugins.title: Barnacle · Plugins
plugins.description: Barnacle plugins have moved to the Barnacle page.

blog.title: Blog
blog.description: Notes from the reef: how Crustates is built, why, and what changes next.

faq.title: FAQ
faq.description: Frequently asked questions about Crustates: install, hardware, compute, storage, networking, upgrades, the AI assistant, licence and community.

catalog.title: App catalog
catalog.description: Curated templates that set up storage, a database, HTTPS on a .crust.internal name and backups for you.

roadmap.title: Roadmap
roadmap.description: Where Crustates is going: milestones M0 to M6, and what comes after.

api.title: Same API everywhere
api.body: Everything on this page is a resource in the Crustates API. Click it in the console, script it with crust, or manage it with OpenTofu.
